excerpt: Parse is Reducto’s foundational endpoint. It converts documents into structured JSON with text, tables, figures, layout, and formatting
Extract pulls specific fields from documents as structured JSON. You define a schema describing the data you need, and Reducto returns values matching that schema
Split identifies which pages contain which sections of a document. You describe sections in natural language, and Reducto returns the page numbers where each section lives.
Route documents by type before processing. Define categories in natural language.
Fill PDF forms and modify DOCX files programmatically with natural language instructions.
